usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.fine_tuning.alpha.graders.run.create(grader: { "type" => "string_check", "name" => "string", "input" => "string", "reference" => "string", "operation" => "eq" }, model_sample: "string", item: { "key" => nil })
pp result

fields.name: grader
fields.description: The grader used for the fine-tuning job.

fields.name: item
fields.description:
The dataset item provided to the grader. This will be used to populate 
the `item` namespace. See [the guide](/docs/guides/graders) for more details.

fields.name: model_sample
fields.description:
The model sample to be evaluated. This value will be used to populate 
the `sample` namespace. See [the guide](/docs/guides/graders) for more details.
The `output_json` variable will be populated if the model sample is a 
valid JSON string.
